name: Fabric IQ
desc: Power BI semantic models served as context for Copilot and agents.
desc_zh: 把 Power BI 语义模型当作上下文提供给 Copilot 和 Agent。
solves: A model asked about revenue guesses at the numbers. Fabric IQ hands it the semantic model, so the answer follows the definitions the business already agreed on.
solves_zh: 模型被问到营收时只能猜数字。Fabric IQ 把语义模型交给它，答案于是沿袭业务方已经商定好的口径。
best_for: You ask Copilot about a metric and need the company definition, not a new one.
best_for_zh: 你问 Copilot 某个指标，需要的是公司既定口径而不是新算一套。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — Microsoft blog, https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2026/09/25/introducing-the-）。 Generally available in Chat and Cowork on 2026-09-25; also confirmed generally available in Cowork by the 2026-10-29 finance post. Part of the Microsoft IQ family of context layers. 首次公开日期来源：https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2026/09/25/introducing-the-new-copilot-with-home-code-and-autopilot/
